Package dev.px.core.render.font

Interface FontProvider

public interface FontProvider
Creates Font handles for the active render backend.

Installed by the version adapter. Everything here is backend specific: a NanoVG provider registers the TTF bytes with the nvg context, a legacy provider bakes a glyph atlas, and both return something that satisfies the same interface.
